description: This file defines the AM_ProjectTemplatesController class which manages project templates, including creating projects from templates, generating Gantt charts, updating tasks, and handling related operations within the SuiteCRM module 'AM_ProjectTemplates'.

classes.name: AM_ProjectTemplatesController
classes.description: Controller class for managing project templates and related project operations within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_view_GanttChart
methods.description: Sets the view for Gantt chart visualization.

methods.name: action_create_project
methods.description: Creates a new project from a template and copies associated resources and tasks.

methods.name: action_generate_chart
methods.description: Generates a Gantt chart visualization for a project template.

methods.name: action_update_GanttChart
methods.description: Updates or creates a project task based on AJAX request data.

methods.name: action_delete_task
methods.description: Marks a project task as deleted.

methods.name: action_get_end_date
methods.description: Calculates and returns the end date for a task, considering lag.

methods.name: action_update_order
methods.description: Updates the order of tasks based on provided sequence.

methods.name: action_get_predecessors
methods.description: Returns options for predecessor tasks in a form.

methods.name: create_task
methods.description: Creates a new task and links it to the project template.

methods.name: IsNullOrEmptyString
methods.description: Utility function to check if a string is null, empty, or whitespace.
